approval._doc: mode never: no human approval anywhere; tiers in auto_tiers execute on their own at any hour, other tiers are recorded as refused and not traded. mode online_hours: the earlier model (proposals 10-22 local, offline_auto_tiers overnight).

spot._doc: long_venue spot (2026-11-01, owner's decision; paper only): the long is the coin itself on its Hyperliquid spot pair (UBTC, UETH), so it pays no funding and the perp funding filter does not apply. fee_taker_pct: Hyperliquid's spot taker fee in %. A spot pair with less than min_spot_vol_m million of 24h volume or a price more than max_basis_pct % from the perp is not used: the long goes on the perp and the reason is recorded. max_x: spot is bought with cash, so the spot longs together hold at most this multiple of the pot (a higher target is capped). A perp long held when the setting changes is closed and re-opened on spot in the next run.

_agent_note: Trend (Doctrine build 2): BTC+ETH, long while the daily close is above its 50-day average, vol-targeted 30%, cap 2x, 25% no-trade band, 15% resident stop. Frozen in docs/specs/TREND.md. Throttle set above the rule's 40% historical drawdown so normal drawdowns do not halt it. Since 2026-11-01 the longs are held as spot coins (target.long_venue), not perps.
